index 000000000..dae944485
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/_pytest/immutable_path_default.py
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+from typing import Literal
+
+
+def immutable_path_default(
+    type: Literal[
+        "string", "paths", "pathlist", "args", "linelist", "bool", "int", "float"
+    ]
+    | None,
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Like :func:`_pytest.config.argparsing.get_ini_default_for_type`, but
+    returns an empty tuple instead of an empty list for the ``"paths"`` type,
+    for use in an immutable configuration preview.
+    """
+    if type is None:
+        return ""
+    elif type == "paths":
+        return ()
+    elif type in ("pathlist", "args", "linelist"):
+        return []
+    elif type == "bool":
+        return False
+    elif type == "int":
+        return 0
+    elif type == "float":
+        return 0.0
+    else:
+        return ""
diff --git a/testing/test_immutable_path_default.py b/testing/test_immutable_path_default.py
new file mode 100644

+++ b/testing/test_immutable_path_default.py
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.config.argparsing import get_ini_default_for_type
+from _pytest.immutable_path_default import immutable_path_default
+import pytest
+
+
+def test_paths_returns_empty_tuple() -> None:
+    assert immutable_path_default("paths") == ()
+    assert isinstance(immutable_path_default("paths"), tuple)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "type",
+    [None, "string", "pathlist", "args", "linelist", "bool", "int", "float", "", "x"],
+)
+def test_matches_get_ini_default_for_type(type: Any) -> None:
+    result = immutable_path_default(type)
+    expected = get_ini_default_for_type(type)
+    assert result == expected
+    assert result.__class__ is expected.__class__
